description: Runs bigin-lint's per-file invariant checks after a write into a Bigin requirements vault (v1.9.0+: `bin/bigin lint --hook --quiet`). QUIET and ADVISORY: only findings about the file just written, at most 5 lines, always exit 0 — and nothing at all while BIGIN_BATCH=1, which the engine sets while it applies change sets, so transient mid-apply states never reach an agent's context. The blocking gate is `bin/bigin lint --full`, run once at each stage boundary. Inert in any repo without _bigin/system/project.md.
